{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH AND with status 'completed'
filtered_df = sales_df[
    (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & 
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Calculate the fraction who converted
n_total = len(filtered_df)
n_converted = filtered_df['converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = n_converted / n_total

n_total, n_converted, fraction_converted"}
